_comment: Sölden corrections. (1) OSM maps the not-yet-built Pitztal<->Sölden connector '(Projekt) Fernerkogelbahn III' as an aerialway; its top sits just inside the west bbox edge right next to the real Tiefenbachbahn, so it can't be dropped by bbox without clipping Sölden's glacier lift. Remove it so routes never board a phantom (unbuilt) lift.
_comment2: False-elevation reversals confirmed by eyeball (check:elevation). Two piste ends near the Giggijoch-area lift stations (~2640 m) and one on the glacier (~3230 m) sampled too low/high, flipping the ski direction uphill. Values are the EU-DEM terrain samples reported by npm run check:elevation soelden. n3229643842 is the same mis-sampled cluster as its neighbour n1613091887 22 m away: sampled 14 m too low, which pointed BOTH of its piste edges inward and left it a one-way dead end (the only node fleet-wide that check:trapped regressed on). Set to 2656 rather than the raw DEM 2659: at 2659 it ties its uphill neighbour exactly, which stops the piste INTO it from descending and merely turns the dead end into an orphan. 2656 is what a monotonic slope between its two neighbours (2659 at 22 m, 2650 at 70 m) gives, so both edges stay descending -- one in, one out.
